reader.requirement: One file may be opened INPUT, OUTPUT, EXTEND and I-O in turn in one run unit, each re-OPEN after a plain CLOSE (or CLOSE NO REWIND) succeeding; an OPEN of a file still open (including after CLOSE REEL/UNIT, which leaves it open) is 41, and after CLOSE WITH LOCK is 38.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector (2002+): at 85 the physical file is locked ('38' through any file-name), from 2002 the file connector

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehavior in FileRegistry.cs: CloseWithLock and ClosedWithLock are the only edition switches on this path; RefusedAsAlreadyOpen and the CLOSE REEL/UNIT Table 14 cell are edition-free
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a CLOSE WITH LOCK locks the physical file (every file-name gets 38), from 2002 only the file connector
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers the four modes in turn after plain CLOSEs; not exercised: re-OPEN after CLOSE REEL, UNIT, NO REWIND and WITH LOCK, relative files

probes.printed: CLOSE-REEL=07 OPEN-AFTER-REEL=41 WRITE-STILL-OUTPUT=00 CLOSE-UNIT=07 OPEN-AFTER-UNIT=41 CLOSE-NOREWIND=07 OPEN-AFTER-NOREWIND=00 OPEN-AFTER-LOCK=38 RL-AFTER-LOCK=38
probes.expected: CLOSE REEL/UNIT leaves the file open so OPEN is 41 and the file stays OUTPUT; CLOSE NO REWIND closes so EXTEND re-opens 00; CLOSE WITH LOCK gives 38 (VII.1.3.5 3e)

probes.printed: OPEN-IO=00 R1=R001 R2=R002 R3=R003 EOF4 OPEN-INPUT=00 RL-IO=00
probes.expected: OUTPUT, EXTEND, I-O, INPUT of one file in one run unit, each after a plain CLOSE, all 00 with the records kept
85: the file closed with lock is the physical file, so another file-name of it also gets 38

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR5  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5
OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.4a

reader.notes: RefusedAsAlreadyOpen answers 41 before anything touches the connector; the CLOSE REEL/UNIT non-unit cell leaves the file open; ClosedWithLock takes the 85 physical-file arm. All forms probed behave as GR5 and VII.1.3.5 require.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR5 (cite.py: OK GR5 'without the REEL, UNIT,'). Probed the forms the reader did not try: CLOSE REEL FOR REMOVAL, CLOSE NO REWIND of an INPUT file, and an EXTERNAL file connector shared by two programs of the run unit (1985 nested program plus EXTERNAL). r5_ext.cob printed MAIN-OUT=00, SUB-OPEN-WHILE-OPEN=41 (the subprogram's OPEN of the run unit's still-open external file), SUB-CLOSE=00, SUB-EXTEND=00, MAIN-REOPEN=00 and MAIN-READ=00 E001. It then printed CLOSE-REEL-REMOVAL=07 with OPEN-AFTER-REMOVAL=41 (the file stays open), and CLOSE-IN-NOREWIND=07 with OPEN-IO-AFTER-NOREWIND=00. Every re-OPEN that GR5 permits succeeds, and every OPEN without a qualifying CLOSE gives 41, or 38 after LOCK (the reader's probe).
